title: Nutanix and Netris Announce Strategic Collaboration to Deliver a Multitenant Infrastructure Stack from Compute to Network for Neoclouds and NVIDIA Cloud Partner Environments
summary: Nutanix and Netris have announced a strategic collaboration to deliver a jointly engineered multitenant infrastructure stack designed specifically for neoclouds and enterprises — combining Nutanix Cloud Platform and its proven capabilities with...
body_markdown:
**[NVIDIA GTC](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/) - Berlin - Oct. 21, 2026** - Nutanix (NASDAQ: NTNX), a hybrid cloud leader and AI platform company, and Netris, the leading provider of Network Automation, Abstraction, and Multitenancy (NAAM) for AI infrastructure, today announced a strategic collaboration to deliver a jointly engineered infrastructure stack designed specifically for neoclouds and enterprises. By combining Nutanix Cloud Platform and Nutanix’s expertise in cloud infrastructure and compute orchestration with the Netris NAAM platform, the joint solution will provide neoclouds and enterprises with a scalable, secure, and multitenant solution across the infrastructure.


As the demand for AI infrastructure accelerates, neoclouds and enterprises are leading the deployment of large GPU clusters to support a broad range of AI workloads. Delivering this infrastructure as a service requires both soft isolation and hard isolation (enforced on networking hardware) that extends across every layer of the infrastructure, from the compute layers and data processing units to the physical switches.


## An Automated Multitenant Infrastructure Stack for AI Clouds


Bringing together Nutanix’s cloud infrastructure capabilities with Netris network automation and multitenancy, the joint solution will provide neoclouds and enterprises with a secure, multitenant AI infrastructure stack across bare-metal and virtualized environments, enabling providers to instantly onboard customers, maintain strict isolation between tenants from compute through the physical network, and deliver AI services through a cloud-like self-service experience.


Key highlights of the joint solution for neoclouds and enterprises will include:


- **Automated Network Fabric Operations** : Simplifies AI infrastructure deployment by automatically configuring the physical network as tenant resources are provisioned, reducing manual effort, accelerating time to value, and improving operational consistency.
- **Unified Multitenant Networking** : Delivers a consistent networking experience across physical and virtual environments by translating Nutanix tenant requirements into the appropriate underlying network services for bare-metal and virtualized GPU nodes.
- **Self-Service Cloud Networking** : Provides cloud-grade networking constructs — VPCs, elastic IPs, NAT, and L4 load balancers — through a web console, REST API, and Terraform, enabling infrastructure to be consumed through a self-service, cloud-like experience.
- **High-Performance AI Factory Networking** : Supports the connectivity for demanding AI workloads, enabling efficient edge, East-West, North-South, scale-up, and host-based networking traffic flows.
- **End-to-End Tenant Isolation** : Extends secure hard and soft tenant isolation across the entire network — from virtual workloads through the physical switching layer — supporting secure, reliable GPU-as-a-Service offerings on shared infrastructure.


## Executive Commentary


" *Neoclouds and[NVIDIA Cloud Partners](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/gpu-cloud-computing/partners/) are at the forefront of the AI transformation, but building the cloud operating stack required to monetize GPU clusters at scale is remarkably complex,* " said **Ketan Shah, Vice President, Product Management, Nutanix** . " *By pairing Nutanix’s Agentic AI solution with the Netris NAAM platform, we will provide AI cloud operators with an out-of-the-box solution to accelerate their journey from metals to margins. We chose to partner with Netris, a leader in network automation, abstraction, and multitenancy, to give operators true self-service networking across both bare-metal and virtualized environments. This will enable our partners to deliver secure, multitenant IaaS environments quickly while maintaining the simplicity and enterprise reliability that Nutanix is known for.* "


“A *I infrastructure is scaling incredibly fast, and the network has to scale with it,* " said **Alex Saroyan, CEO and Co-Founder of Netris** . " *An AI cloud needs two layers working as one — Nutanix's compute orchestration and virtualization, backed by deep operational leadership and experience, and Netris network automation, abstraction, and multitenancy. What makes this collaboration matter is that those layers stay continuously in sync, giving neoclouds and enterprises a single automated stack for secure, multitenant GPU services.* "


## Analyst Commentary


*"AI infrastructure providers are evolving beyond GPU capacity to deliver trusted inference environments, workload orchestration, agent lifecycle management, and managed AI services. The differentiator will be a cloud-like operating model that combines performance with control, isolation, and security at every layer of the stack.”*


- **Steve McDowell, Principal Analyst, NAND Research**


## Availability


The joint solution is planned to be available in tech preview in early 2027.


### About Nutanix


Nutanix is a hybrid cloud leader and AI platform company, offering organizations a unified infrastructure software platform to safely run applications, data, and AI anywhere. Trusted by customers worldwide, Nutanix empowers more than 50% of the Global 2000 to innovate faster with AI, while modernizing infrastructure, simplifying operations, and controlling costs. Learn more at[www.nutanix.com](https://www.nutanix.com/) or follow us on social media.


### About Netris


Netris is the leading provider of network automation and multitenancy for AI infrastructure, purpose-built for neoclouds, sovereign AI operators, and AI factories. The Netris NAAM (Network Automation, Abstraction, and Multitenancy) platform delivers network orchestration for AI clusters, hard multitenancy enforced on networking hardware, and cloud-provider-grade automation across Ethernet, InfiniBand, DPUs, and virtual and edge networking — from Day Zero design and simulation through live operations. Netris enables operators to launch GPU clouds in weeks, provision tenants instantly with isolation configured automatically, and maximize GPU utilization by dynamically reallocating capacity across tenants. Netris is the most widely deployed network automation platform for AI clusters, with 70+ live deployments. Founded in 2018 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Netris is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Learn more at[netris.io](http://netris.io/) .
